item.title: Judge blocks plan to return Trump's name to the Kennedy Center
item.description: The judge ruled that the arts center's board may not put Trump's name back up on the building, saying such a change needs Congressional approval.

item.title: Tiny krill are turning up in deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Scientists want to know why
item.description: Antarctic krill serve as a crucial food source for penguins, seals, and whales. They recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers say they've found krill in a surprising place: hydrothermal vents.

item.title: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers
item.description: Farmers in states bordering Canada say they are reeling from President Trump's trade wars and resulting retaliatory tariffs. And it's just not neighborly.

item.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
item.description: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: NATO jets shoot down a drone in Lithuanian airspace
item.description: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv.
